import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s4=np.sin(0.4*t); c4=np.cos(0.4*t); s8=np.sin(0.8*t); c8=np.cos(0.8*t)
    return (p[0] + p[1]*P + p[2]*P*P + p[3]*np.log(P) + p[4]*t
            + (p[5] + p[6]*t + p[7]*s4 + p[8]*c4 + p[9]*c8 + 0.0*s8 + 0.0*t*t)/P)
